bib.title: Multi-Task Deep Neural Networks for Natural Language Understanding
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 57th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL), pages 4487-4496

question: Can multi-task learning on top of a pre-trained BERT encoder yield more general text representations that improve NLU tasks and adapt to new domains with fewer labels?
hypothesis: Multi-task learning and language model pre-training are complementary, so combining them improves NLU performance and domain adaptation.
contributions: MT-DNN: BERT as shared encoder with task-specific output layers, refined by multi-task learning
New state of the art on ten NLU tasks (SNLI, SciTail, eight of nine GLUE tasks)
Representations adapt to new domains with substantially fewer in-domain labels than BERT

method.summary: Shared BERT encoder (lexicon + Transformer) with task-specific heads (classification, SAN-based pairwise, regression, pairwise ranking) is further trained on all nine GLUE tasks by sampling mini-batches from a shuffled merged pool, then fine-tuned per task. Domain adaptation tested on SNLI and SciTail with subsampled training data.
method.task: multi-task natural language understanding (GLUE, SNLI, SciTail)

datasets.name: GLUE (9 tasks)
datasets.size: CoLA 8.5k, SST-2 67k, MNLI 393k, RTE 2.5k, WNLI 634, QQP 364k, MRPC 3.7k, STS-B 7k, QNLI 108k train
datasets.split: train/dev/test as in Table 1; test scored on GLUE server

datasets.name: SNLI
datasets.split: 0.1%, 1%, 10%, 100% of train randomly sampled, five times

datasets.name: SciTail
datasets.split: 0.1%, 1%, 10%, 100% of train randomly sampled, five times

models.name: MT-DNN (large)
models.architecture: BERT-large bidirectional Transformer shared encoder + task-specific heads

models.name: ST-DNN
models.architecture: same as MT-DNN but shared layers are plain pre-trained BERT, fine-tuned per task

training.objective: Multi-task: cross-entropy (classification), MSE (STS-B), pairwise ranking negative log likelihood with softmax over candidates (QNLI); one task per mini-batch
training.regularisation: stochastic prediction dropout in SAN; gradient norm clipped to 1

other.pretraining: uses released BERT models; MLM + NSP

inference.samples: domain adaptation: random subsampling five times, mean reported; GLUE single runs

eval.protocol: GLUE test via server (Feb 25 2019 leaderboard); dev results in Table 3; adaptation mean of 5 samplings

terms.definition: Multi-Task Deep Neural Network: shared encoder layers with task-specific top layers trained on multiple NLU tasks

lineage.work: Representation learning using multi-task deep neural networks (Liu et al. 2015)
lineage.note: original MT-DNN, here with BERT encoder
SAN answer module for pairwise classification
